tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Build a complete invoice as structured data: invoice number, issue and due dates, line items, discount, tax, total and payment terms. Nothing is stored. Use when the user wants an invoice for a client. Do NOT use for totals only (use calculate_totals) or for a printable text version (use render_invo

tools.name: calculate_totals
tools.description: Compute subtotal, discount, tax and total for a list of line items (discount applied before tax, amounts rounded to 2 dp). Use for quick totals math without building an invoice. Do NOT use to produce an invoice document; use create_invoice.

tools.name: supported_currencies
tools.description: List the currency codes InvoiceGen accepts for invoices (USD, EUR, INR, GBP, AED, SGD, AUD, CAD). Use before create_invoice when unsure whether a currency is supported. No exchange rates or currency conversion are provided.

tools.name: render_invoice_text
tools.description: Build an invoice from the same inputs as create_invoice and return it as a plain-text document (header, line items, subtotal, discount, tax, TOTAL DUE, notes) ready to paste into an email or message.
